definitions: A mythical Pokémon of the Psychic type, known for its alien-like appearance and ability to change forms (Attack, Defense, Speed, and Normal Forme).
In the Pokémon universe, Deoxys is often depicted as a space-virus Pokémon that mutated upon exposure to a laser beam.
examples: The trainer caught Deoxys in the game.
Many fans consider Deoxys to be one of the most unique Pokémon.
